intended_object: The subgroup of the pointwise group of all functions α → β (where β is a topological group) made up of the continuous functions. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
The definition extends `continuousSubmonoid`, whose underlying set is {f | Continuous f}. That submonoid contains 1 because constant maps are continuous, and it is closed under multiplication because of `ContinuousMul`. The definition adds closure under inversion through `Continuous.inv`. So its underlying set is exactly the set of continuous maps, inside the pointwise group α → β.

The hypothesis `IsTopologicalGroup β` is just `ContinuousMul β` together with `ContinuousInv β`. These are the properties the proof uses, so the definition is stated at its natural generality. The bundled type `C(α, β)` with its group structure is a related but different object (a group, not a subgroup of α → β). This definition is Mathlib's own version of the notion, so there is no separate counterpart to cite.
